name: Smoke Plume
text: An enemy rises from it after the Snuff Strike. Stand on it to block it (take 1 damage) or strike it to pop it.

name: Lit Shrine
text: A lit Votive Shrine: heals 1 HP to each Wickfolk piece on or adjacent to it at Tally.

name: First Light
text: The first-player token. In Vigil it chooses the Toll; in Last Flame its holder acts first each round.

name: Crown Socket
text: Fills gold on each CHECKMATE against the Guttered King (at most 3).

name: Bounty Seal
text: "Wanted": felling the hero of the sole Glory leader earns +3 Glory more.
